# KaTeX 0.19.0

Official browser distribution from https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz.

Registry SHA-512 integrity, verified before copying:
`sha512-v6Tznz3zJ7u3niRCoDTsumM2+HA2XXcCu+WAacCeHD2z3p9A9Ks987o5FzfTGBN0e8A0vjEgIDvLbICrXpdw/Q==`.

The JavaScript, stylesheet and fonts are served locally. Upstream files are unmodified. MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

Rendering options: https://katex.org/docs/options.html. Chat rendering disables trusted commands, limits expansion/size, and uses fresh macros for each formula. Code fragments are excluded before math parsing.
